title: NotMC Network
description: NotMC Network is a Vietnamese Minecraft server offering fun game modes like Earth, SMP, Skyblock, and EcoSword for players to explore, survive, and play together.
body:
# 🌍 Welcome to NotMC Network 🌍

## NotMC Network is a Vietnamese Minecraft server built for players who love exploration, survival, progression, and community gameplay.

Explore exciting game modes such as Earth, Skyblock, and EcoSword, each offering a different way to play, build, fight, and grow. Whether you enjoy creating your own island, surviving in a large world, or developing your strength through an economy-based adventure, NotMC Network gives you the freedom to choose your own journey.

### 🏠 A Place to Play Your Way
Build your base, collect resources, trade with other players, upgrade your progress, and enjoy a friendly Minecraft community. NotMC Network is designed for both new and experienced players who want a fun and active server to play on.

### ⚡ Server Features

- 🌍 Earth survival experience
- ☁️ Skyblock gameplay
- ⚔️ EcoSword progression
- 💰 Economy system
- 🏗️ Building and survival
- 👥 Friendly community
- 🎯 Events and challenges
- 📈 Player progression

Explore. Build. Survive.

Welcome to **NotMC Network** — a place where every player can start their own Minecraft adventure.

🖥️ **Discord**: https://discord.gg/notmc

📚 **Website**: https://notmc.net
